description: Enterprise ecommerce platform for B2B and B2C digital storefronts, order management, and unified commerce experiences
auth_notes: OAuth2 / JWT Bearer tokens via Salesforce Login and API Access Services (SLAS for shoppers, Account Manager for admin APIs).
credential_notes: Requires enterprise contract, commercial Salesforce partnership, or paid organizational account access to provision environments and API clients.
api_notes: Extensive APIs including Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI), Open Commerce API (OCAPI), and Einstein API covering products, baskets, orders, and customer data.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Salesforce. Community options or custom integrations would need to be built independently.
rationale: While the platform provides robust public REST/SOAP APIs, obtaining production or developer sandbox credentials requires an enterprise account, partnership, or sales engagement rather than self-serve free sign-up.

evidence.note: Describes OAuth2 standards, JWT access tokens, and SLAS/Account Manager client setup for SCAPI Admin and Shopper APIs.
Lists the comprehensive Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) surface covering catalogs, orders, customers, and shoppers.
Overview page indicating Commerce Cloud solutions require organizational licensing and enterprise configuration structures.
